items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Phil Schaap - nobody’s found that music yet. But I saw him, he was writing that music out.

ctx.x: It was gonna be for eight pieces. I’ve asked about it. Phil Schaap - nobody’s found that music yet. But I saw him, he was writing that music out. Coleman Hawkins knew what he was.
They were playing with Max together, that’s right.
